_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform, distinct from the shared ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🔣️oracle.json manifest. ⚠️ The `dwg-ac1018-any` and `dwg-ac1024-any` catalogs declare the SAME three kinds, and that is correct rather than a copy-paste: `4️⃣ac1018/🪆️subsets/✳️any/🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🦀️.rs` is a one-line `pub use` of `🔟ac1024`'s, as are its `🧬️schema` and `📸️snapshot` facets, so `DwgMutation` is ONE Rust enum shared by both standards. They are identical BY CONSTRUCTION, not by agreement, and the AC1024 oracle module's `every_ac1018_facet_is_a_re_export_of_this_one` test reads the committed sources and fails the moment that stops being true. Two catalogs and two capabilities exist anyway because the contract gate counts coverage per subset and a catalog claimed by no feature is itself a breach.

oracles.rationale: 📖️ A third-party READER of the DWG file header, run as a separate process and never linked, so its GPL-3.0 licence stays with the tool. `dwgread -v3` traces the preamble fields it parses — the version code, `maint_version` and `codepage` — before it decodes the R2004+ section map, and refuses a document shorter than a container with the byte count it was given. The case's oracle role writes every document it produces to disk and requires that reading to agree with the semantic-dwg-preamble-v1 projection (`dwgread_agrees` in `../🔮️oracles/🦀️.rs`); the mutation itself is applied by the independently hand-written preamble writer beside it. Verified on the committed architectural drawing (AC1024, maint 2, codepage 30) and on AC1032/maint 7/codepage 29 and 22-byte preamble-only documents. Installed on macOS through Homebrew (`libredwg`); Ubuntu 24.04 and Windows ship no package, so there the oracle phase records the case as oracle-unavailable with the missing command.

comparisonProfiles.description: DWG documents compared by the publicly specified preamble — the six-character version string, the maintenance-version byte and the codepage — plus the document's own byte length. `byteLength` is NORMATIVE here, not writer freedom: the rest of an R2004+ container is a proprietary section map that neither side can rebuild, so the length is the only way a whole-document replacement is observable at all, and neither side has any latitude over it. Nothing beyond the preamble is projected, because nothing beyond the preamble can be read independently of this repository's own decoder; a profile that claimed more would be claiming evidence that does not exist.

provenance.attribution: Handcrafted before/after vector authored directly against this subset's own documented schema — Law 2's handcrafted-vector category.

fixtureManifests.notes: Handcrafted before/after pair reusing this exact subset's own committed set-snapshot DwgSnapshot fixture (LibreDWG-cross-checked against the real architectural.dwg header) as `before`; `after` overwrites SetVersionInfo{version:"AC1024",maintenanceVersion,codepage:1252} — the AC1018 tree's own mutation aggregate re-exports this exact leaf from AC1024 (`pub use crate::artifacts::dwg::standards::v_ac1024::subsets::any::schema::mutations::*`), so one real implementation backs both subsets.
